message.content: Add GitHub login to the notes app using NextAuth (Auth.js) with the Prisma adapter.

content.text: Added Auth.js with the GitHub provider and the Prisma adapter, so users, accounts and sessions are stored in PostgreSQL. The auth() helper is used in server components to read the session, and middleware protects the /notes routes. I added the Account, Session, User and VerificationToken models to schema.prisma and created a migration.

message.content: Login works locally but fails on Vercel.

content.text: AUTH_SECRET and the GitHub callback URL were missing in production. I documented AUTH_SECRET, AUTH_GITHUB_ID and AUTH_GITHUB_SECRET in .env.example, and the GitHub OAuth app needs the callback https://<domain>/api/auth/callback/github. Also set AUTH_TRUST_HOST=true when running behind a proxy.
